selection_rule: Compare every frozen neighbor at both full20k seeds0/1; include explicitly previously measured corrected f000/f001 controls. Rank complete paired mean cell distance then donor energy; retain failures, sampleSD, spread and coverage. New weights/optimizers at0 for every new fit.
confirmation_rule: Distinct primary-distance, joint-quality and released-reference choices require fresh full20k initialization seeds2..4; no exploratory score is independent confirmation.
